text:
sarah: quick sanity check — seeing a billing mismatch on a couple of customer cases. they call streaming generate with a cached prefix and the API response shows `completion_tokens: 40` but billing shows ~120 units billed.

sarah: minimal repro: POST /v1/generate with `stream: true` and `origin_hint: cached_prefix_v2`. payload looks normal. my hypothesis is that the streaming finalization path is re-counting the cached prefix when calculating billed tokens.

sarah: repro snippet:```json
{
  "model": "redwood-13b",
  "input": "<user prompt>...",
  "stream": true,
  "origin_hint": "cached_prefix_v2"
}
```

mike: do we have `cached_tokens` surfaced in the response for streaming? i thought we only add that for non-streaming flows. billing joins on usage.tokenlineage and chargeable_units — could be a mismatch there. :thinking_face:

julia: tagging the runtime folks — if streaming sends incremental deltas, the final aggregator needs to subtract any cached prefix once. otherwise the ledger will count prefix+delta. can you paste a raw event/log showing the computed `chargeable_units`?

sarah: i grabbed a log sample, see the last line where we compute units: `computed_billable = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens + cached_tokens` — that looks wrong for cached hit. should be `computed_billable = (prompt_tokens - cached_prefix_count) + completion_delta` when origin_hint present.

kevin: yep that's the bug. streaming finalizer currently treats cached_tokens as always billable. quick options:
- small runtime fix: exclude cached_prefix_count in finalizer when `origin_hint` indicates a cache hit (backcompat safe)
- API surface: add explicit `billable_units` field in response so billing and SDKs don't need heuristic joins (breaking change avoided if additive)

kevin: prefer runtime fix first for safety, then follow up with `billable_units_v2` in the schema to make reconciliation explicit. both changes are additive so shouldn't break older clients.

mike: +1 for runtime patch. if we add `billable_units_v2` we should also emit an event in usage table with `billing_source=stream_finalizer` to make audits easy.

julia: can you also check the case where prompt truncation happens server-side? if we truncate prompt for length and cache applied earlier, prompt_tokens reported in API might differ from what the cache used, causing negative numbers in the delta calc. need clamp logic. :eyes:

kevin: noted — will clamp and ensure we never subtract more than prompt_tokens. i'll open a tiny PR to runtime that: 1) detects `origin_hint` cache hits, 2) adjusts finalizer to exclude cached_prefix_count, 3) emits `billable_units_v2` in response as opt-in header `X-Billable-Units-V2` and body field when `?include_billable=true`.

sarah: awesome. can you drop the PR link here & I'll coordinate a quick deploy? low-risk patch but want a canary first.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout for runtime/finalizer patch on west-1 at 2026-04-02T18:00Z. will post results.

kevin: PR: https://git.redd.in/runtime/pull/834 — includes unit tests for streaming cached prefix and prompt truncation clamp.

sarah: i'll run a reconciliation between usage table and API test corpus after the canary. if numbers look good we'll roll to prod. thanks all. :raised_hands:
